dedupe_keys.name: dataset for recurrent neural networks for short term water demand forecasting a technical review and framework for implementation 2026

description: The authors of a 2026 technical review publish a structured extraction of 42 studies on recurrent neural networks for short-term water-demand forecasting. The README defines an Excel workbook with a dataset sheet, abbreviations and references. It covers publications from 2018 to 2025, recording model architectures, forecast horizons, temporal resolution, input variables, preprocessing, tuned hyperparameters, performance indicators and benchmark models. Zenodo makes the workbook freely available under CC BY 4.0. A modeller can use it to compare forecasting choices and locate calibration or validation studies before building an operational demand simulation. It contains literature-derived metadata, not raw utility demand observations. Geographical completeness and comparability of performance scores across studies remain uncertain. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this review extraction. The README was inspected, while the workbook was not downloaded.
